ns0:svg.data-production-method: Native outlined type, frame contours, icons, counters and rarity stars; retained artwork, brush materials and logo masks.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Paper, Rock, Scissors

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
POWER: Both players reveal the top card of
their Life Deck. Whoever reveals the higher
card number puts that card in their hand.
The other player shuffles theirs into their
Life Deck. On a tie, both shuffle theirs back.
